title: ロイヤルプリンセスハンドプレス☆

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh, I still have some time left before training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I know. Why don't I put on a fruit face mask before I go? ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe, a princess must maintain her elegance with proper skin care!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hehe. ♪ There really is nothing like smashing a pineapple with your bare hands!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: But I'm not done yet! I need to mash it up even more—really squeeze out those beauty-boosting ingredients!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhh! I'm such a dummy! I've destroyed the whole thing!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: No! A princess never gives up! There are still plenty of pineapples left!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Gyaah! The juice squirted into my eyes! One more time!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Kawakami Princess gets so caught up in her fruit-smashing undertaking that she completely forgets to come to training…
